mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkin_ai_jobs ( id, user_id, checkin_id, checkin_date, status, attempts, max_attempts, last_error, next_run_at, locked_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{checkinId}, #{checkinDate}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{maxAttempts}, #{lastError}, #{nextRunAt}, #{lockedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), checkin_date = VALUES(checkin_date), status = VALUES(status), attempts = VALUES(attempts), max_attempts = VALUES(max_attempts), last_error = VALUES(last_error), next_run_at = VALUES(next_run_at), locked_at = NULL, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, checkin_id, checkin_date, status, attempts, max_attempts, last_error, next_run_at, locked_at, created_at, updated_at FROM checkin_ai_jobs WHERE checkin_id = #{checkinId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, checkin_id, checkin_date, status, attempts, max_attempts, last_error, next_run_at, locked_at, created_at, updated_at FROM checkin_ai_jobs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND checkin_date = #{checkinDate} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, checkin_id, checkin_date, status, attempts, max_attempts, last_error, next_run_at, locked_at, created_at, updated_at FROM checkin_ai_jobs WHERE status IN ('pending', 'failed') AND next_run_at <= #{now} AND attempts < max_attempts ORDER BY next_run_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE checkin_ai_jobs SET status = #{runningStatus}, locked_at = #{lockedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
UPDATE checkin_ai_jobs SET status = #{status}, attempts = #{attempts}, last_error = #{lastError}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE checkin_ai_jobs SET status = #{status}, attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, locked_at = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
